about.title: About Imperial Tours
about.description: Curated journeys for the discerning traveler, run by a team that lives and works in Egypt.
about.lead: We are a small Cairo team who would rather run twelve journeys properly than a hundred carelessly.
about.storyTitle: Founded on the ground, not in a brochure
about.storyBody: Imperial Tours began with two guides and one Nile itinerary. Every route we sell, we have walked ourselves — at the hour we recommend you walk it, in the season we recommend you come. That is why our days start early and our groups stay small.
about.storyBody2: We employ our guides directly, own the cars that meet you, and answer the phone ourselves. Nothing about your trip is quietly handed to a third party you never agreed to.
about.value1Body: Capped so a guide can answer every question, and so you are never queuing behind your own party.
about.value2Body: Egyptology-trained, directly employed, and working in English, Spanish and German.
about.value3Body: What we quote is what you pay. No fuel surcharge on arrival, no shopping stops we are paid to make.
about.value4Body: A real person replies within a working day, in your language, before and during your trip.
about.teamBody: Your guide, your driver and the person who answered your first email all work for us. When something changes on the day — a closure, a delay, a sandstorm — they can fix it between themselves without anyone waiting on an agency.
about.ctaBody: Browse the journeys we run, or tell us what you have in mind and we will build it around you.
